guidance.statement: We expect capex per store over a longer period to be lower than INR 2.5 crore and that to continue going forward.
guidance.quote: If you therefore look at our capex over the last six months, nine months or a longer period, and the capex per store for that period, you will find it is lower than INR 2.5 crore. We expect that to continue going forward.

guidance.statement: We broadly expect NAOVs to remain in the same range, though they might climb up in Q3 because of seasonality.
guidance.quote: In Q3, they might climb up again because of seasonality, but broadly, we don't think they should move up in a meaningful way.
